entities.name: Jacinto de Romarate
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacinto de Romarate Salamanca was a Spanish Navy officer who fought in the British invasions of the River Plate and on the Royalist side during the Argentine War of Independence. Back in Spain, he participated in the First Carlist War.
